players.product: Neocloud GPU compute platform: sovereign AI factories in Australia and New Zealand running NVIDIA B300 / GB300 clusters (GPU-as-a-service, AI platform layers, high-performance storage); NVIDIA Cloud Partner

quarterly_data.signal: SharonAI 8-K: successful delivery and customer acceptance of the initial AI Cloud deployment for a global technology company with a major Asia-Pacific presence, completing a key milestone under the five-year AI Cloud infrastructure agreement with a total initial contract value of approximately US$950m; acceptance also triggers release of cash security held in escrow. The deployment is the first phase of the contract and part of a series of additional NVIDIA GPU clusters SharonAI expects to deliver over the coming months across multiple data centers in Australia, with revenue expected to commence in stages across the third and fourth quarters of 2026.
quarterly_data.figure: initial deployment accepted under ~US$950m contract; revenue in stages across Q3 and Q4 2026
